scope: Blog 6 writer-service visuals 08a–08d; two ClickHouse Cloud writer nodes, 2 vCPUs and 8 GiB each.

axes.x: Cumulative raw NewPart rows divided by 113217743918; CPU-stage buckets aggregate raw-row progress over 30 minutes.
axes.bytes: Decimal MB/GB/TB; stored size includes initial part metadata.

08a.ingestion: Unique successful raw-table NewPart bytes_uncompressed / actual bucket wall seconds.
08a.merges: Whole-service metric_log ProfileEvent_MergedUncompressedBytes / actual bucket wall seconds. Repeated processing included.
08a.total_processing: Ingestion bytes + merge bytes; processing work, not unique bytes ingested.
08a.efficiency: Same numerator / (ProfileEvent_OSCPUVirtualTimeMicroseconds / 1e6). MB per CPU-second equals MB/s per average busy core.
08a.cpu_scope: Whole writer service, including work beyond matched benchmark ingestion and merges.

08b.cpu_total: Successful AsyncInsertFlush QueryFinish executions joined to successful quotes_daily_mv executions by initial_query_id; UserTimeMicroseconds + SystemTimeMicroseconds. Query completion allowed up to 60 seconds after cutoff, only for IDs matched to in-window MV executions.
08b.classification: Mutually exclusive symbolized CPU-trace categories. Precedence: Sorting, Compression, Parsing, Pre-aggregation, Other ingestion. Background-merge scope classified separately and excluded from the ingestion stage breakdown. Compression excludes decompression-only frames.
08b.allocation: For each host and 30-minute bucket, recorded ingestion CPU microseconds × stage samples / all ingestion samples; sum hosts.
08b.cpu_work: Stage CPU microseconds / raw quotes × 1000 = CPU-ms per million quotes.
08b.shares: Stage CPU microseconds / recorded ingestion CPU microseconds × 100.
boundaries: Sample-based stage allocation is an estimate, not an exact stage timer.
Pre-aggregation excludes destination sorting and compression.
Complete view CPU includes view processing and destination writing, and is not pure aggregation.
Sorting profile counter is elapsed time; it is not added to CPU time.
Shares use ingestion CPU work, not all service CPU or installed capacity.

08c.compression: Cumulative unique successful raw NewPart bytes_uncompressed / cumulative size_in_bytes; initial stored part writes, not current final storage.
08c.initial_summary: MV input/output rows reconcile with unique NewPart rows. Initial output includes partial summary rows.
08c.maintained_summary: Cumulative summary NewPart rows + completed MergeParts output rows - completed MergeParts read_rows. This reconstructs maintained rows from part counters; it is not a direct system.parts snapshot.
assumptions: No active-window mutations or part-event errors.
Part-producing event counts equal unique part-name counts.
Pre-run activity used different table UUIDs.
Full name-by-name lineage diagnostics exceeded the unchanged scan guard and are not used.
08c.displayed_factor: Raw cumulative quotes / displayed maintained-summary rows; paired values and factor use the same observation.
08c.later_snapshot: Current system.parts and summary coverage are supporting October 10 snapshots, kept separate from active-run chart curves. last_modified in the current-part CSV is the part modification time, not export collection time.

08d.merge_throughput: Whole-service metric_log ProfileEvent_MergedRows / actual bucket wall seconds. Input rows processed by background merges; includes repeated processing and does not count rows eliminated.
08d.parts: Five-minute max of service metric MaxPartCountForPartition across both nodes and all metric samples. This is service-wide rather than filtered to one benchmark table.
08d.part_consolidation: Supporting MergeParts events are unique by table UUID and part name; merged_from counts inputs; each event produces one replacement. DownloadPart events excluded to avoid replica duplication.

resources.cpu: Smoothed OSCPUVirtualTimeMicroseconds / smoothed wall seconds / 4 vCPUs. Aggregate average use; no individual core activity is measured.
resources.memory: CurrentMetric_MemoryTracking: average snapshots per host/second, average host/seconds in each five-minute bucket, then sum both node means. Both nodes present in every bucket.
resources.memory_capacity: CGroupMemoryTotal remains 8 GiB per node, 16 GiB total.
resources.unused: Arithmetic complement of each utilization percentage. CPU complement does not establish extra sustainable workload throughput. Memory counter accounts for server allocations; its complement is not an OS free-RAM measurement.
resources.dashboard_reference: The retained dashboard-reference export sums snapshots by event_time and averages. Its whole-run mean differs from the node-based calculation by less than 0.05%.

smoothing.boundary: Truncate at observed endpoints; actual overlapping partial-bucket durations and midpoints.
smoothing.rates_and_shares: Ratios of weighted counters and weighted denominator totals, not averages of per-bucket ratios.
smoothing.states: Maintained summary-row count and maximum parts use duration-weighted means.
smoothing.cumulative: Raw cumulative volumes and initial-part compression factor use actual totals without smoothing. The maintained row-reduction factor divides actual cumulative raw rows by the smoothed maintained state.
smoothing.retrospective: Centered windows include later observations within the historical run.

publication.source_csvs: Source exports retain numeric counters and UTC timestamps. Hostnames use stable writer-node-1 / writer-node-2 aliases. Repeated query text and execution IDs from sample diagnostics are removed. Table UUIDs remain as benchmark table identities.
publication.manifest: source-manifest.json maps each SQL query to its CSV results, columns, cell encoding, hashes and extraction status. Queries without retained successful results are explicitly marked and do not feed charts.
publication.reproduction: derive.py regenerates every derived CSV, exact chart payload and this provenance using Python standard library only.
